00057 void NullUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int /*blockID*/, const int /*channel*/) throw()

00070 #if !defined(UGEN_VFP) && !defined(UGEN_NEON) && !defined(UGEN_VDSP)
00071 void ScalarUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int /*blockID*/, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00072 {       
00073     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00074     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00075     LOCAL_DECLARE(float, value_);
00076     
00077     // this is faster on the Mac with compiler optimisations on the Mac sice it
00078     // gets replaced by vectorised operations!
00079     memset(outputSamples, 0, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00080     for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i)
00081         outputSamples[i] += value_;
00082 }
00083 #endif
